run_poem_sentiment_preprocessing: run the poem sentiment dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_poem_sentiment_dataset: create a PoemSentiment classification dataset instance with negative, positive, and no_impact sentiment labels
load_poem_sentiment_hf: load the poem sentiment dataset from Hugging Face using the load_dataset method
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a Hugging Face dataset split to a list of verse text and sentiment label tuples
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot train, dev, and test splits from the PoemSentiment dataset with a specified seed
